notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Decaying Soil, causing you to pay {1} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
